site.name: BetterGram
site.tagline: A practical setup guide for BetterGram.
site.description: Install BetterGram, sign in with your Telegram number, enable the features you want, and connect an optional hub for shared community extras.

features.title: Phone Number Login
features.description: Start BetterGram, enter your Telegram phone number, confirm the login code, then enter your cloud password if your account uses 2FA.

features.title: BetterGram Settings
features.description: After login, open Settings > BetterGram. Enable only the tools you want: ghost messages, privacy cleanup, themes, AI services, hubs, and media helpers.

features.title: Ghost Messages
features.description: When someone deletes an incoming message, BetterGram keeps the original content locally and shows it greyed out without covering it with a deleted badge.

features.title: Always-Show Timestamps
features.description: Force HH:MM to appear on every message bubble type, including media layouts that normally hide timestamps.

features.title: Character Counter
features.description: Show a live character count in the compose box so long messages are easier to manage.

features.title: Link De-tracker
features.description: Strip common tracking parameters such as UTM, fbclid, gclid, and msclkid before links open in your browser.

features.title: Hide Sponsored Messages
features.description: Remove sponsored message surfaces from the client so your chat list and channel reading stay cleaner.

features.title: Typing Indicator Suppressor
features.description: Add peer IDs to a local suppress list so BetterGram skips sending typing notifications for those chats.

features.title: Hub Profiles
features.description: Connect a hub URL to show BetterGram profile colors, animated avatar URLs, and role badges to other hub users.

features.title: Hub Reactions
features.description: Use hub-hosted reactions and shared visual extras between BetterGram clients. Normal Telegram users see standard Telegram messages.

features.title: External File Cards
features.description: Cloud links from providers like MEGA, Drive, Dropbox, Gofile, and Pixeldrain can render as richer file bubbles for BetterGram users.

features.title: Bulk Media Download
features.description: Right-click a chat and download recent media in batches instead of saving every file one by one.

features.title: Floating Voice Mini-Player
features.description: Use a compact always-on-top window for active voice chats with speaking indicators and call controls.

hubExplainer.headline: How to set up and use a BetterGram Hub
hubExplainer.subheadline: Optional community extras for BetterGram users.
hubExplainer.description: A Hub is a lightweight server you connect from Settings > BetterGram. It does not replace Telegram login. It only adds shared BetterGram extras like badges, profile colors, hub themes, announcements, and external file cards.

points.title: Run or choose a hub
points.description: Use a public hub URL, or self-host bettergram-hub with Docker on your own machine, VPS, or community server.

points.title: Set the hub URL
points.description: In BetterGram, open Settings > BetterGram > Hub and paste http://localhost:8080. Add the admin token only if you manage that hub.

points.title: Configure community extras
points.description: Admins can assign badges, colors, announcements, and theme palettes. Users can set their profile extras where the hub allows it.

points.title: Telegram stays normal
points.description: The hub does not receive Telegram credentials or replace MTProto. Non-BetterGram users simply see normal Telegram content.

faq.q: What do I do first after launching BetterGram?
faq.a: Enter your Telegram phone number, confirm the login code, and finish 2FA if enabled. Then open Settings > BetterGram and turn on the features you want.
No. Use BetterGram without a hub for local client features. Hubs are only for shared extras such as badges, profile colors, reactions, announcements, external file cards, and hub themes.

faq.q: How do I connect a hub?
faq.a: Open Settings > BetterGram > Hub, paste http://localhost:8080, save, and restart if the feature asks for it. The local Docker tutorial uses admin token bettergram-local-admin for admin-only actions.

faq.q: Can normal Telegram users see hub features?
faq.a: No. Hub features render only for BetterGram users connected to the same hub. Everyone else sees normal Telegram messages and links.
Deleted incoming messages stay visible locally and are shown greyed out. BetterGram does not draw a Deleted badge or icon over the content.
